scope: Strict lower bound only: R^2<9/2. Equality classification, Lean verification and public integration are separate gates. Entries classify a selected positive component together with its ambient minimizing ten-packing, not individual geometric realizations.
selection_convention: Strictly subcritical n=10 lower bound; choose the jointly generic planar physical stress, including the reviewed loaded-ring polynomial and open-interval normal restrictions, before classifying a nonzero positive component. Use the strict/nonradial/nondiagonal VV normals, loaded-ring concurrence-polynomial exclusions and open intervals, and compatible planar physical replacement described in CASE_ROADMAP.md. All choices precede classification; no assertion about every alternative stress.
partition_rule: Use the ordered C00..C20 tree in CASE_ROADMAP.md. Retain its 19 leaves other than C05/C20. In C05 suppress only unloaded degree-two vertices of the whole positive graph and split by (k,b); omit (2,0), which cannot be branching. In C20 use the frozen 279 canonical S/D words. Proven necessary reductions may make entries empty.
closure_rule: Close an entry only when a reviewed theorem excludes every realization under its stated hypotheses. Refinements, sample exclusions and conditional core lemmas never add entries or close a whole entry by themselves.

entries.title: Entirely loaded cyclic component that is not a seven-body simple cycle
entries.scope: The all-loaded reduction forces an enclosing seven-cycle in a strictly subcritical ten-packing.

entries.title: Seven loaded bodies with a common signed frame offset
entries.scope: Includes the smooth uniform ring and the radial-side/diagonal endpoints.

entries.title: Nonuniform strict one-chirality seven-ring
entries.scope: After C02: the fixed side/vertex pattern, allowing reflection and cyclic relabeling. A hand cap theorem traps all three inner squares below the three-square minimum radius.

entries.title: Other seven-loaded-ring contact ownership
entries.scope: For the jointly selected certificate, outer-row extra corners have squared norm below 33/20. The enlarged core boundary and all SS/SV/VS/VV caps place the three inner squares below squared radius 83/50, contradicting 425/256. This closes every loaded seven-ring ownership pattern.

entries.title: Mixed simple cycle of length at most four
entries.scope: All load assignments.

entries.title: Mixed simple cycle of length at least five with at most two loads
entries.scope: The two-terminal transmission-path theorem applies to a whole simple cycle.

entries.title: Five-cycle with three loads and adjacent unloaded bodies
entries.scope: The middle loaded body touches every other loaded body.

entries.title: Three-loaded five-cycle with radial-side central body
entries.scope: Nonadjacent unloaded bodies; the central loaded square has two geometric circle vertices. S-S, mixed S-D, and D-D are all excluded.

entries.title: Unique-circle-vertex central body: parallel transmissions
entries.scope: Nonadjacent unloaded bodies; apply this predicate before C11–C17.

entries.title: Unique-circle-vertex central body: coincident contacts
entries.scope: After C10; equal and mixed transmission types are excluded.

entries.title: Unique-circle-vertex central body: two distinct vertex contacts
entries.scope: After C10–C11.

entries.title: Unique-circle-vertex central body: two side-normal transmissions
entries.scope: After C10–C12; includes two side-interior contacts.

entries.title: Remaining vertex/side pattern: D-D
entries.scope: First letter is the transmitter at the central vertex contact; second is at the side-interior contact.

entries.title: Remaining vertex/side pattern: S-S
entries.scope: Same ordered convention as C14; vertex exclusions and an analytic side-interior clearance proof rule out the entire S-S pattern.

entries.title: Remaining vertex/side pattern: S-D
entries.scope: Same ordered convention; physical torque balance forces a far vertex to carry circle load, while elementary analytic bounds place it strictly inside the circle.

entries.title: Remaining vertex/side pattern: D-S
entries.scope: Same ordered convention; endpoint classification and a printed exact clearance table exclude both remaining circle-load patterns.

entries.title: Five-cycle with four loads: side transmitter
entries.scope: Its only unloaded body is a degree-two side transmitter.

entries.title: Five-cycle with four loads: diagonal transmitter
entries.scope: For the generic selected certificate, D transmitter neighbors must be contacted in side interiors. The nearer-endpoint theorem forbids side support, excluding the component. The certificate is selected before classification.
